items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: So after a while, the MP and the SP left, and they went back

ctx.x: When they went in there, they went in to clean it, and you had the little sitting vestibule and then you have the regular toilet. And they were in the toilet together, cleaning this thing. At that particular time, the MPs and SPs were patrolling trains, looking for guys AWOL from the Army and the Navy, etcetera. So they had two guys on there that were up and down, walking through the train all the time. It so happens that they came by and took a seat where these toilets were. And while they were sitting there,…

So these guys, when they're getting ready to come out, they see the SP and the MP sitting out there. And all of us thought that if they had been smart, they would have just walked past, but in a thing like that, you panic. What they did was close the door again, and took this stuff and put it behind the stool in the toilet, came out and sat back down. So after a while, the MP and the SP left, and they went back
